events.title: Freddie Mercury passing anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy with Queen – truly one of a kind.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Timeless Beatles album
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A masterpiece that truly pushed boundaries and still sounds fresh today.

events.title: John Lennon passing anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost a true visionary. John Lennon's music and message of peace resonate as strongly as ever.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: The Starman's birthday
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. Forever pushing boundaries, forever missed. What's your favourite Bowie track?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy heavenly birthday, King
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the one and only King, Elvis Presley. Still shaking up the airwaves and inspiring generations.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitar legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar icon's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll forever. What's your go-to Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy birthday, Rod!
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still got that unmistakable voice and stage presence.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: One Step Beyond for Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the fantastic Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing joy and ska to generations. What's your favourite Madness hit?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British 'blue-eyed soul' singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever he lays his hat...
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That smooth voice defined a generation. What's your favourite track from the '80s icon?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to Dolly
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music, her heart, her enduring legacy.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy birthday, Gaz!
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to solo hits, a true legend of British pop. What's your favourite Gary Barlow moment?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British R&B and pop star Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Get outta our dreams...
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to Billy Ocean! Still bringing sunshine and incredible hits to the airwaves.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony.

angles.name: Hall of Fame history
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame welcomed its very first class of legends. Who do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer-songwriter Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy birthday, Mark!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That to his solo ventures, still a pop favourite.

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on this day in 1969.

angles.name: That iconic rooftop gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles took to the rooftop for their legendary final live performance. A truly iconic moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Award-winning singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In the air tonight...
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A drumming powerhouse and a voice behind so many classic hits.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy birthday, Hugh!
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to darker roles, a true British screen icon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, singer, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's big day
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband sensation to solo chart-topper, he's still bringing the moves and the hits.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor Sir David Jason, known for 'Only Fools and Horses' and 'A Touch of Frost', celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely jubbly birthday!
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering music legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, the music world lost three incredible talents. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop icon Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never gonna give him up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the legend that is Rick Astley! Still owning the charts and our hearts.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the timeless Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting legend whose music has soundtracked generations.

events.title: Whitney Houston passing anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the world lost the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: 15 years today, we remember the voice of a generation, Whitney Houston. Her music lives on, forever cherished.

events.title: Take That split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop phenomenon Take That announced their initial split.

angles.name: A day pop fans remember
angles.copy: 31 years since the news broke that Take That were splitting up. A moment that truly shocked a generation of pop fans!

events.title: Ali Campbell (UB40) turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 lead singer Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine and a birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell! The iconic voice of UB40, still bringing the reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy birthday, Ed!
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! From busking to stadium tours, what an incredible journey.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering George
angles.copy: On what would have been his 84th birthday, we remember the unique talent of George Harrison. His music truly lives on.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Hope he doesn't get fooled again
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Roger Daltrey! The powerful voice of The Who, still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British pop and new wave singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Wouldn't it be good...
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to Nik Kershaw! An '80s icon with a string of unforgettable hits.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman and global superstar Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Half a century of Chris Martin
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to Chris Martin! The voice and heart of Coldplay, still filling stadiums worldwide. What's your top Coldplay track?

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman and rock icon Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Living on a prayer...
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi! Still rocking stages and hearts around the world.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of British singer-songwriter Chris Rea would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Driving Home for Chris
angles.copy: Remembering the smooth sounds of Chris Rea on what would have been his 76th birthday. Forever driving home for Christmas in our hearts.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: Motown legend and co-founder of The Supremes, Mary Wilson, would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Stop! In the name of Mary
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Mary Wilson of The Supremes on what would have been her 83rd birthday. A true Motown icon.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk debut anniversary
events.blurb: Michael Jackson introduced the iconic Moonwalk dance for the very first time at Motown 25: Yesterday, Today, Forever on this day in 1983.

angles.name: The day the Moonwalk landed
angles.copy: 44 years ago, Michael Jackson debuted the Moonwalk and changed dance forever. An unforgettable moment in pop culture history!

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Pioneering electronic musician Gary Numan celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Are 'friends' electric?
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the innovative Gary Numan! A true electronic music pioneer whose influence is still felt today.
